items.value: Damn you! I told you, open access to the ingredients! Degenerate elemental, what can I do with you?!
CALL A RESPONSIBLE ADULT TO ACCESS DANGEROUS INFORMATION
"Stupid piece of iron, I'll... you!
Loud crash
What kind of nonsense is going on at grandma's place?
Grandma, is everything okay? Are you okay?

No way! I tried to teleport some mandrake root and vanilla for the potion from the warehouse, but this useless piece of iron wouldn't do it! She even turned on some kind of child mode, damn it! Does she even know how old I am?! This is just plain disrespect for elders.
Hmm... maybe I should go to the warehouse myself? Get the ingredients?
Oh, that's unlikely, I just went there, it's such a mess... silly Alice! She ruined everything!
I AM LARISA, LEATHER BAG.
What did you call me?! I'll melt you right now, you little brat!
An untranslatable pun using Elvish idioms
Grandma, grandma, that's enough, calm down. She just got the wrong update, that's why she...
I'll give her a refresh now! I'll spend three ninth-level magic cells on her now! I'll...
Granny, I'll go to the warehouse myself, I'll bring everything myself! Just don't blow up the house!
I'm not promising anything! Go to the warehouse already, you idiot!

I was playing "Secret Kingdom" there with my friends once. Steffon and Miklouha were evil, and I was good. But then we accidentally summoned a lion familiar, and Grandma forbade us from entering the warehouse.
What the... cat? AACHOO! AACHOO!
Be healthy, lad
Wow, a talking cat? ACHOO!
Well, I'm not a fish. I'm Tomegeb. The owner here appointed me warehouse supervisor, oh my!
And she taught you to speak, huh?
Well, of course! Keepers, it seems, aren't supposed to be without a voice! What did you come here for, boy?
I'm looking for ingredients. Can you tell me where, uh...

I can't tell you. You see what a mess it is here. Everything's out of order, remember? I've been sitting here for hours now, trying to do everything by the book, and so far I've only managed to open the door out there. The owner gasped when she saw what was going on here. What on earth did you decide to risk, boy?
Yes, grandma is angry, Larisa won’t give her the ingredients for the potion, and now she wants to melt this piece of iron...
Oh, that's right thing
... along with the house.
Oh, my. Right. Okay, kid, let me think... Yeah, I got it. There should be a switch for Lariska somewhere in the warehouse, pull it and turn this thing off.
Can you tell me where to look for this switch?

Ooooh, well, it should be somewhere near the magical artifacts. There are signs on the ceiling here, use them to navigate, kid, otherwise you'll get completely lost. Good luck to you, I'll keep fixing the crystals here.
Oh! Got it? I had no doubts about you, you're a great boy, a good grandson to grandma!
Thank you very much. ACHOO!
Meow
Oh, have you done everything yet? I was thinking maybe I should run to the owner...
It's a labyrinth, not a warehouse! I thought I'd never get out!
It's okay, the boy is still alive.
Hey, kid, are you alive in there? I found the switch myself!
Oh, my God, I thought I was stuck! How did you do that?
"It's a working secret, then. And anyway, if you know too much, you'll grow old!"
So, where are the ingredients, actually?
Come on, boy, I'll show you everything now. I have everything here, so nothing gets lost.
So... mandrake root and vanilla. Everything's here. Oh, thank you. We need to hurry before grandma gets completely pissed off.
Just make sure you try, I really need this little house!
Oh, you're done yet? Well done, grandson, you never let me down! Come on, let's hurry up and get cooking, otherwise Gvinka is already sleepy.
Gvinka?
Oh, so we'll prepare a potion for her, "Prancing Pony", to help her back heal.
Wait, us?
Well, the process is quite complicated, and it’s easier for me to maintain a magic circle than to cook
Yeah, she left all the hard work to her beloved grandson! Oh-oh-oh!
Hey, you're young, you can handle it, no need to make things up! Okay, let's cook!
